source:
Imagine a fashion game called Runway Royale. It has the fun of creating outfits and competing in fashion shows, but with much more to do between rounds.
🌟 Main Lobby
As players join, they enter a huge luxury fashion mall with glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, music, and a spinning central runway. Around the lobby are portals to different game modes, a daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, and event stage.
👗 Dressing Booths
Instead of everyone changing in the open, every player gets their own private dressing booth.
Full-length smart mirrors
Outfit save slots
Makeup and hair stations
Skin tone and body customization
Accessory organizers
Outfit randomizer
Favorite clothing section
Booth themes you can unlock (Fairy, Modern, Princess, Cyber, Beach, Cottagecore, etc.)
🛍️ Non-VIP Fashion Area
Everyone can use hundreds of beautiful items including:
Dresses
Jeans
Skirts
Jackets
Hoodies
Sneakers
Heels
Boots
Hats
Glasses
Hairstyles
Makeup
Jewelry
Bags
Nails
Face accessories
New free clothes are added every week so non-VIP players never feel left behind.
💎 VIP Fashion Lounge
VIP players enter through sparkling golden doors into a luxury boutique.
VIP includes:
Exclusive designer collections
Animated dresses
Wings
Luxury gowns
Fantasy outfits
Premium hairstyles
Designer handbags
Exclusive makeup
Particle effects
Glowing accessories
Special poses
VIP-only dressing booths
Private runway practice room
VIP chat lounge
🎭 Fashion Themes
Every round gives a random theme, such as:
Mermaid Royalty
First Day of School
Pop Star
Vampire Queen
Winter Wonderland
Space Explorer
Cottage Princess
Y2K
Gothic Glam
Red Carpet
Fairy Forest
Pirate Captain
Summer Vacation
Magical Academy
Celebrity Look
Players have 5 minutes to create their outfits.
✨ Runway Show
When time is up:
Players walk down a stunning animated runway.
Spotlights follow each model.
Cameras flash.
Music changes with each round.
Players strike poses before reaching the judges.
⭐ Voting
Instead of simple stars, players earn points for:
Creativity
Theme accuracy
Styling
Color coordination
Overall wow factor
The top three receive crowns, confetti, and bonus rewards.
🏆 Progression
Players level up through fashion ranks:
Fashion Rookie
Trendsetter
Style Icon
Elite Designer
Supermodel
Fashion Legend
Runway Royalty
Higher ranks unlock badges, titles, booth decorations, and special victory animations.
📸 Extra Features
Outfit photo studio
Trading accessories
Fashion clubs with friends
Weekly tournaments
Seasonal battle pass
Daily styling challenges
Pet companions
Color wheel with millions of shades
Fabric textures (silk, denim, velvet, lace, leather)
Weather effects on runways
Fashion magazine where winning outfits are displayed
🌈 Why it stands out
Instead of only dressing up and voting, players can collect rare clothing, decorate their own dressing booth, climb fashion leagues, complete quests, trade cosmetics, join fashion teams, and explore a beautiful world that keeps growing with new updates. It feels like a fashion-themed adventure rather than just a runway game, making it deeper and more rewarding while staying fun for casual players.

answers.ask: Is the mall lobby, the runway and the VIP wing all one continuous space, or does each mode sit on its own map reached through the portals?
answers.answer: Keep the luxury mall lobby and VIP wing as one continuous shared space, with portals leading to separate runway-show maps for rounds.

answers.ask: Are the dressing booths private per-player instances, or physical rooms in the shared lobby that anyone can walk into?
answers.answer: Dressing booths are private per-player instances, so each player can customize outfits without others entering or seeing their booth.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D fashion game layout centered on a huge, continuous luxury fashion mall lobby. A spinning central runway anchors the main hall, surrounded by glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, portals to separate runway-show maps, a daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, and event stage. Connect a VIP wing to the shared mall through sparkling golden doors, containing a luxury boutique, VIP-only dressing booths, a private runway practice room, and chat lounge. Use private per-player dressing-booth instances with smart mirrors, makeup and hair stations, accessory organizers, and clothing display sections. Include a fashion magazine display area for winning outfits.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is `Roleplay & Avatar Sim`, using the Dress Up context of outfit customization and a fashion venue. `Party & Casual` is secondary because runway shows occur as separate competitive rounds; it does not own the overall hub shape.

### Shape and preset
Use `hub-portals`, taken from outside Roleplay & Avatar Sim’s usual shapes. The luxury mall is a shared destination hub whose portal bank leads to separate runway-show maps, while its VIP wing remains physically connected. The closest Roleplay preset is Dress Up, but the hub-and-destination-map structure replaces its `stage-runway` shape, so the preset is none.

### Config requirements
Use `social-hub` for the oversized central mall hall where players gather around the spinning runway. Use `landmark-focal` for that runway as the visual anchor beneath the billboards and elevators. Use `teleporter-link` for clearly readable portals leading to separate show maps. Use `vignette-photo` for the dedicated photo studio and magazine-display compositions.

### Layout requirements
Place `teleporter-link` markers as one grouped portal bank around the main-hall perimeter, with one portal per separate runway-show destination; the destination count is unspecified. Their paired endpoints belong on the separate show maps. No other gameplay markers are specified. Private dressing booths are instanced per player and must not be laid out as publicly enterable rooms in the shared mall.

### Layout components
The large enclosed mall lobby centers on a circular spinning runway, with glowing waterfall walls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, the daily-reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, event stage, and fashion-magazine winner display arranged as distinct perimeter attractions. Broad polished walkways radiate from the runway to each attraction and to the portal bank. Sparkling golden doors on one side open directly into the connected VIP wing: a luxury boutique, VIP dressing-booth instance access, a private runway-practice room, and a chat lounge. Dressing-booth instances contain smart mirrors, makeup and hair stations, accessory organizers, and clothing-display sections. Frame the composition from above with the runway as the center, public amenities in a readable ring, and the gold VIP wing as a strong side branch.

### Render order
Use `topdown` first and as authoritative, because the hub circulation and its transitions to separate show maps must remain clear and valid before the isometric dressing pass.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by the expansive mall, numerous public attractions, connected VIP wing, and separate show-map destinations. Theme: glossy luxury fashion mall, neon billboards, glass, waterfalls, gold, and theatrical glamour. Use `P4` because the portal-linked runway-show maps and private player booth instances are separate maps rather than one coexisting surface.
